verdictExplanation: The tool suggests an urgency category for patient referrals, so it touches clinical decisions about patients using health information sent to a US-hosted model. That puts it at indicative tier III and likely triggers a FIPPA privacy impact assessment, a supplementary assessment for storage outside Canada and a medical-device classification check. None of these blocks the project, so it can go ahead with those conditions and a clinician making every final triage decision.

intake.title: Specialist referral triage assistant
intake.processDescription: Today, intake nurses at a regional specialist clinic read every incoming referral letter, check that the required tests and history are attached, and place the referral in an urgency category before a triage clinician confirms it and books the patient. Backlogs reach several weeks. We want a large language model to extract referral details, flag missing information, suggest an urgency category with the reasons, and draft a one-paragraph summary for the triage clinician, who makes the final decision.
proposedKpis: Median days from referral to triage decision
Share of referrals returned for missing information

subtasks.name: Extract referral details
subtasks.description: Pull patient identifiers, referring clinician, reason for referral and attached results from the letter.
subtasks.rationale: Structured extraction with clear fields; errors are caught at the next step.

subtasks.name: Check referral completeness
subtasks.description: Compare attached tests and history with the clinic's referral criteria and list what is missing.
subtasks.rationale: The criteria are written down; a missed item delays care but is recoverable.

subtasks.name: Suggest urgency category
subtasks.description: Propose an urgency category with the clinical reasons found in the referral.
subtasks.rationale: Under-triage can delay urgent care; the category bears directly on the patient's wait.

subtasks.name: Draft triage summary
subtasks.description: Write a short summary of the referral for the triage clinician.
subtasks.rationale: An inaccurate summary could mislead the clinician, so it is reviewed against the letter.

subtasks.name: Confirm triage and book
subtasks.description: The triage clinician confirms or changes the category and books the appointment.
subtasks.rationale: This is the clinical decision about the patient.

assumptions: Referral letters arrive as text or searchable PDFs.
The clinic's referral criteria are documented.
